name: Review Slider for WooCommerce
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Turn Your WooCommerce Product Reviews Into High-Converting Sliders, Carousels & Grids Anywhere on Your Store.

Review Slider for WooCommerce makes it easy to showcase your best WooCommerce product reviews and customer testimonials on your homepage, shop page, landing pages, product pages, or sidebars.

With one click, sync your existing WooCommerce customer reviews into the plugin’s dedicated table (utf8mb4 emoji-ready) and automatically sync newly approved product reviews as they come in. Each review can display the product image and link directly to the WooCommerce product, turning customer feedback into a storewide conversion engine.

Why Choose Review Slider for WooCommerce?

  • Show Product Reviews Anywhere: Don’t leave your best 5-star reviews buried at the bottom of individual product tabs. Display a storewide WooCommerce review slider or product review carousel on your homepage, checkout page, or landing pages.
  • Product Photos & Direct Product Links: Automatically pull the featured WooCommerce product image and product link alongside each customer review so shoppers can click straight through to buy.
  • Current-Product Filter (Filter By Post): Place a single review template on your WooCommerce product pages and enable the Post ID filter to automatically show only reviews for the product currently being viewed.
  • Built-In Review Analytics Dashboard: Track your store’s average star rating, 1-to-5 star breakdown, review volume timeline, rating trends over time, and positive/negative keyword word clouds right inside wp-admin.
  • Fast Local Database Performance: Synced reviews are served directly from your own WordPress database — zero external API requests, full page-caching compatibility, and fast Core Web Vitals.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Responsive Review Slider, Carousel, Grid & List: Display WooCommerce product reviews in a smooth horizontal slider or a multi-row, multi-column responsive grid.
  • One-Click & Automatic WooCommerce Sync: Import all existing approved WooCommerce product reviews in seconds and automatically sync new reviews when they are approved.
  • Two Template Styles + Live Preview: Choose between Style 1 (classic speech bubble) and Style 6 (modern review card layout) with a live preview in the template editor.
  • Expandable Read More Links: Trim long product reviews and add a customizable Read More link so your sliders stay clean and uniform.
  • Per-Product Filtering: Show all store reviews together in a summary slider, or turn on Filter By Post so product pages only show reviews for that specific product.
  • Full Design Customization: Customize star visibility, review dates, background colors, text colors, border radius, reviews per row, total rows/slides, and custom CSS.
  • Smart Sorting & Text Filters: Sort product reviews by Newest or Random, and optionally hide rating-only reviews that do not include written text.
  • Display Anywhere: Add unlimited review templates to any page, post, Elementor/block section, or sidebar using the Review Slider for WooCommerce block, a shortcode, or a WordPress widget.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store homepages & shop pages
  • Storewide customer testimonial sliders & carousels
  • Product page review sliders (filtered by current product)
  • High-converting sales & landing pages
  • Sidebar & footer WooCommerce review widgets

Check Out Our Other Free Review Slider Plugins

  • Google Reviews
  • Facebook & X (Twitter) Reviews
  • Yelp Reviews
  • TripAdvisor Reviews
  • Airbnb Reviews
  • Thumbtack Reviews
  • Zillow Reviews

Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro for More Features

Want to automate post-purchase review request emails, combine Google/Facebook/Amazon/Etsy reviews with your WooCommerce reviews, and unlock 15 template styles? Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro:

  • Automated WooCommerce Review Request Emails (Autoresponders): Automatically send branded review request emails a set number of days after a WooCommerce order is completed — with customizable email templates, open/click tracking, and direct links to your product or review form!
  • 150+ Review Sites & Platforms: Combine your WooCommerce product reviews with reviews from Google, Facebook, Amazon, Etsy, Trustpilot, Reviews.io, Yotpo, Feefo, Judge.me/Custom Sources, Ebay, Walmart, Wayfair, Best Buy, Target, Flipkart, Yelp, TripAdvisor, and 130+ other platforms!
  • Push Form & External Reviews Into WooCommerce: Collect product reviews (with customer photos and videos) via a front-end submission form and automatically sync them into native WooCommerce product reviews.
  • Google Product Ratings XML Feed & Rich Snippet Schema: Generate a Google Shopping Product Ratings XML feed under Tools and output valid JSON-LD AggregateRating schema markup for Google Search star snippets.
  • AI Review Summaries & Deep AI Analysis: Display an AI-generated “Customers Say” summary above your product reviews, run full AI Sentiment & SWOT Analysis reports (themes, pain points, buyer personas, and action items), and generate AI Owner Responses.
  • 15 Review Template Styles (Including Dedicated WooCommerce Product Layouts) & Masonry Grids: Unlock 15 template designs (such as Style 11 with left-aligned WooCommerce product images), Masonry grids, continuous-scroll carousels, custom breakpoints, and child-theme overrides.
  • Interactive Front-End Header, Search & Pagination: Add a front-end search bar, sort dropdown, rating/source filter, tag filter pills, Load More button, Endless Scroll, or numbered pagination.
  • 7 Summary Badge Styles, Floating Badges & Slide-Out Drawers: Display storewide WooCommerce rating badges, pin floating review badges or pop-ins to the corner of your store, and open a slide-out review drawer on click.
  • Shareable Social Media Review Cards & Email Signatures: Turn 5-star product reviews into high-resolution PNG social graphics (with Google Fonts & Unsplash backgrounds) and build live-rating email signatures.
  • Auto-Translate, Webhooks, CSV Import/Export & White-Label: Translate reviews via Google Translate API, send new reviews to Zapier, Make, or n8n via webhooks, receive low-review email alerts, sync with TrustGuide, bulk-edit tags/categories/post IDs, import/export CSVs, and enable Agency White-Label Mode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the review-slider-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install Review Slider for WooCommerce from Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Review Slider in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Go to Sync Reviews, enable WooCommerce review sync, and click Save Settings to import your product reviews.
  5. Check Review List and Analytics to view your synced reviews and rating charts.
  6. Go to Templates, create a review slider or grid, then insert the Review Slider for WooCommerce block or paste the shortcode anywhere on your store.
sections.faq:
Are WooCommerce reviews stored on my server?

Yes. WooCommerce product reviews are synced into your WordPress database on your own server. Your store serves those reviews locally with zero external API calls for fast page loads and full caching compatibility.

Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated on your site because this plugin syncs and displays your WooCommerce product reviews. (If you want to import reviews from 150+ external platforms like Google, Facebook, Amazon, or Trustpilot with or without WooCommerce, check out WP Review Slider Pro.)

Can I display all product reviews together on my homepage?

Yes! By default, a review template creates a storewide summary slider or grid showcasing reviews across all of your WooCommerce products — complete with each product’s image and link.

Can I display reviews for only the current product on a product page?

Yes. Enable Filter By Post (Turn on Post ID filter: Yes) in your template settings. When that template is placed on a WooCommerce product page, it will automatically show only the reviews for that specific product.

Does it sync new WooCommerce product reviews automatically?

Yes. Once sync is enabled on the Sync Reviews page, newly approved WooCommerce product reviews are automatically added to your Review List.

Can I create multiple review sliders and grids?

Yes. You can create unlimited templates with different styles (Style 1 or Style 6), colors, row/column counts, and slider or grid settings.

How do I request a feature?

Post on the WordPress.org support forum or contact us on the WP Review Slider website.
sections.changelog:
1.10

  • Added a Setup Wizard, opened from the Welcome page, that syncs your WooCommerce product reviews, helps you pick a look, and adds them to a page.
  • Added a Review Slider for WooCommerce block so a saved template can be inserted in the block editor.
  • The block shows the selected template in the editor.
  • Edit Template in the block toolbar opens that template in a new tab.
  • Refresh in the block toolbar reloads the template preview.
  • Open Templates opens in a new tab and reminds you to refresh the editor after creating a template.
  • Added previews of Pro template styles 16 and 17 on the Templates page.
  • Added a rating request to the admin footer on the plugin’s pages.
  • Slider setting and Style 6 display fixes.
  • The Card style (Style 6) now uses fixed review text and date sizes, so it looks the same with any theme.
  • Fixed the Card style (Style 6) grid stacking into one column on some themes when the rating badge is beside the reviews.
  • Reviews no longer show the WooCommerce bag icon in the corner (Card style and the style previews).
  • Fixed stray commas between the Edit, Delete, and Shortcode buttons on the Templates page.

1.9

  • Checks the reviews table encoding on update and converts legacy utf8 (3-byte) tables to utf8mb4 so reviews containing emojis can be saved.

1.8

  • Changes to the opt-in feature.

1.7

  • Small bug fixes and email opt-in option.

1.6

  • Admin UI updated to match other WP Review Slider plugins.
  • WordPress 7.0 admin styling updates.
  • Improved Sync Reviews settings page.
  • Fixed settings saved messages.

1.5

  • Fixed PHP 8.2 warning notice.

1.4

  • Updated color picker JavaScript.

1.3

  • Small bug fixes.

1.2

  • Small CSS improvements.

1.1

  • Small bug fixes.

1.0

  • First release.
